stages.storyBeat: Wake after the last honest night of your life.
stages.headline: FLORIDA MAN — you danced until the fire died. The crabs stole your Cold One.
stages.name: Dawn Bonfire
stages.blurb: Wake on the beach. Press E at the bonfire (or click the prompt) to start your legend.

stages.storyBeat: The crabs stole your Florida Dew. Reclaim the glowing can, then follow the beach.
stages.headline: VIRAL: Florida Man wakes to missing Florida Dew — crabs named persons of interest
stages.name: Daytona Hangover Beach
stages.blurb: Comedy first. Reclaim The Cold One. Face the King of the Tide Pool. Hangover wears off with the can.

stages.storyBeat: Steve spots GulfGulp's logo on the cooler shipment. Why is a soda company shipping wildlife equipment?
stages.headline: BOARDWALK: Influencer selfie-flash blinds vendors — runaway hotdog cart declared sovereign
stages.name: Boardwalk Chaos
stages.blurb: Tourists, fleas, mustard trails. Keep your flip-flops. Jump the fryer oil.

stages.storyBeat: GulfGulp deliveries pass through this gas station. The slushie line is guarded far better than it should be.
stages.headline: NEON: Slushie machine files restraining order — HOA binder cited as blunt instrument
stages.name: Gas Station of Legends
stages.blurb: Sticky floors. Neon pumps. Unlock Golf Cart Bandit energy.

stages.storyBeat: The delivery route leads to the drive-thru. Its newest employee has scales and a suspicious uniform.
stages.headline: PARKING LOT: Karen requests supervisor of physics — clipboard hydra forms
stages.name: Strip Mall Showdown
stages.blurb: Clipboards, carts, flash stuns. Chaos rhythm unlocks.

stages.storyBeat: A collared gator guards the drive-thru. Get past it so Steve can trace who supplied that hardware.
stages.headline: UNEASE: Drive-thru gator refuses to supersize — GulfGulp radio collar beeping on live stream
stages.name: Drive-Thru Disaster
stages.blurb: Miniboss Drive-Thru Gator. First radio collar. Science experiment gone wrong.

stages.storyBeat: The collar shipment came through this canal. Follow it into the swamp, using the pads to escape deep water.
stages.headline: CANAL: Jet-ski bandits rewrite wake rules — cottonmouths rattle a warning first
stages.name: Canal Run
stages.blurb: Water edges, jump pads, burrow snakes. Depth optional. Chaos mandatory.

stages.storyBeat: The oil gators and fire lizards wear matching collars. GulfGulp turned wildlife into security guards.
stages.headline: STEVE: 'It IS Florida… Anything is possible in the swamp I guess.' — oil gators confirmed
stages.name: The Swamp Shift
stages.blurb: Mutant oil-gators + fire lizards. Captain Steve sting. Animals aren't the enemy.

stages.storyBeat: The conspiracy leaves a paper trail.
stages.headline: CATHEDRAL: Summoner hosts swamp open mic — cottonmouths RSVP under collars
stages.name: Cypress Cathedral
stages.blurb: Summoners, burrowers, cypress gloom. Keep hissing back.

stages.storyBeat: Sludge trails lead toward a logo.
stages.headline: BAYOU: Oil puddles elect themselves mayor — GulfGulp drones take attendance
stages.name: Sludge Bayou
stages.blurb: Puddle layers and collared oil gators. Skim or slip.

stages.storyBeat: Evidence on a corkboard. Next stop: turtle nests.
stages.headline: SHACK: Corkboard links pelicans, collars, and GulfGulp stock — lab coats arrive early
stages.name: Conspiracy Shack
stages.blurb: Bully pelicans and lab coats. The conspiracy gets loud.

stages.storyBeat: Rescue is the mission. Pipelines wanted 'no habitat.'
stages.headline: RED TIDE: GulfGulp 'cleanup' crew oils nests — Florida Man declares turtles under protection
stages.name: Turtle Beach / Red Tide
stages.blurb: Rescue turtles. Their cleanup is a cover. Unlock Turtle Paladin.

stages.storyBeat: Shell up. The facility gate is next.
stages.headline: NEST WATCH: Drones clock in for overtime — baby turtles demand snacks and justice
stages.name: Nest Guard Night
stages.blurb: More turtles to free. Red tide and mark-drones try to stop you.

stages.storyBeat: The logo on the gate matches the collars. Follow the pipes to the lab and find the records.
stages.headline: GATE: 'Authorized personnel only' — Florida Man cites pelican testimony
stages.name: GulfGulp Gate
stages.blurb: First look at the facilities. Hazmat grunts and welders.

stages.storyBeat: They engineered the gators. The memo is the smoking gun.
stages.headline: LAB FILE: 'Engineered gators to guard spills' — memo stamped CONFIDENTIAL, still sticky
stages.name: Mutant Lab Wing
stages.blurb: Mutant adds, fire lizards, collared gators. Evidence everywhere.

stages.storyBeat: Middle management of doom blocks the docks.
stages.headline: PIPES: Barrel rollers unionize mid-gauntlet — Rig Overlord clocks in early
stages.name: Pipe Gauntlet
stages.blurb: Pipe-maze platforms. Chargers in metal halls. Keep your footing.

stages.storyBeat: The barge is loading. You are not invited — you go anyway.
stages.headline: DOCK: Offshore crabs punch in late — corporate security loses clipboard war
stages.name: Loading Dock Riot
stages.blurb: Offshore crabs meet hazmat. Sideways vs clipboard.

stages.storyBeat: Jump the gaps. The platform is a silhouette ahead.
stages.headline: BARGE: Storm pelicans claim airspace — gaps in the deck rated 'Florida'
stages.name: Barge Crossing
stages.blurb: Barge gaps. Hoppers and jet-ski leftovers. Don't fall in the joke.

stages.storyBeat: The helipad waits. So does the Spillfather.
stages.headline: PLATFORM: Approach rated hostile by anonymous pelican — slicks bloom under the rig
stages.name: Oil Platform Approach
stages.blurb: Welders, drones, slicks. Finale is close.

stages.storyBeat: One more headline between you and the Spillfather.
stages.headline: HELIPAD: Closed for mutant maintenance — wind push rated 'personality'
stages.name: Helipad Hysteria
stages.blurb: Last security wave. Wind push set piece. Then the sludge mech.

stages.storyBeat: The Spillfather and the last captive turtles are here. Defeat the mech and free every turtle before sunrise.
stages.headline: FINALE: The Spillfather makes an offer Florida Man can't refuse — he refuses, for the turtles
stages.name: GulfGulp Rig
stages.blurb: Oil-exec sludge mech. Save remaining turtles. Sunrise credits.
